definitions.gloss: skilled worker; experienced craftsman; master artisan
definitions.explanation: A worker who has achieved a high level of skill and expertise through extensive training and experience, particularly in manufacturing or craftsmanship.

examples.japanese: {熟練工|じゅくれんこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{再現|さいげん}→再現：09777_saigen⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: The skills of a master craftsman cannot be replicated by machines.

examples.japanese: {熟練工|じゅくれんこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{不足|ふそく}→不足：03598_fusoku⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧だ。
examples.english: A shortage of skilled workers is the challenge.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い⟦{世代|せだい}→世代：05102_sedai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{熟練工|じゅくれんこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{技|わざ}→技：02172_waza⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦どう→どう：00543_dou⟧⟦{伝|つた}える→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧になっている。
examples.english: How to pass on the skills of experienced craftsmen to the younger generation has become an issue.

notes: A compound of ⟦{熟練|じゅくれん}→熟練：09081_jukuren⟧ (mastery, skill through experience) and {工|こう} (worker, craftsman). Japan's manufacturing sector has long depended on {熟練工|じゅくれんこう}, and the aging and retirement of these workers is a significant social issue known as the ⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦{伝承|でんしょう}→伝承：11458_denshou⟧ (technology succession) problem. Compare with ⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧ (craftsman, artisan, broader term) and ⟦{技術者|ぎじゅつしゃ}→技術者：17049_gijutsusha⟧ (engineer, technician).
